verdict.rationale: Bruno is a local-first, offline desktop/CLI app that stores collections as plain text files on the user's own filesystem, with no cloud account, no forced sync, and available cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) plus Docker images for CI use, effectively making self-hosting/running the core product entirely under user control the default mode rather than an add-on. This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to self-host the core product without vendor infrastructure. missing for 10: no explicit self-hosted server/enterprise deployment guide (e.g. self-hosted license server or team sync backend) and no independent hands-on report specifically validating self-hosting at scale.
